scope_note: Reference baseline for checking that datums referenced by GD&T specifications have a corresponding Datum Feature Indicator in the drawing. The supplied table points Datum Feature Indicator to ISO 5459, but no ISO 5459 edition or clause was supplied; this configuration therefore does not establish normative applicability or an edition-specific compliance claim.

rules.subject: datum_feature_indicator
rules.requirement: A datum referenced by the GD&T review must have a corresponding detected datum feature definition before the review can consider the reference resolved.
rules.source_ref: Datum related symbols table: Datum Feature Indicator -> ISO 5459
